NewsArticle.Title: Testing Begins
NewsArticle.Content: Second phase of testing begins Dark Ages continues accepting applications for role-playing beta testers through 99.02.10. Private beta-testing for talented role-players will be offered on these dates: - 99.01.11: Chaos Age - 99.01.17: Chaos Age application deadline - 99.01.30: Atavism Age application deadline - 99.02.01: Atavism Age - 99.02.01: Final Application deadline - Spring, 1999: Dark Ages release Apply: [www.darkages.com/test](http://www.darkages.com/test/index.html).
